name: Master of Executions

bonuses.name: Architect of Ruin
bonuses.text: The GM gains 1 point of Ruin at the start of each of this Threat's turns.

bonuses.name: Champion
bonuses.text: This Threat may use Ruin Actions and has 2 personal Ruin.

bonuses.name: Mark of Chaos
bonuses.text: This Threat has the Mark of Chaos(KHORNE) (W&G p.136)

bonuses.name: Space Marine Implants
bonuses.text: Gain bonus dice and options for actions from Space Marine Implants (W&G p.75)

abilities.name: Limb Slicer
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin. When this Threat successfully hits they deal +2 Mortal Wounds.

abilities.name: Head Taker
abilities.text: When this Threat successfully hits with their Axe of Dismemberment with a Wrath Critical in melee they roll twice on the Critical Hit table and select the best result.
The Threat is also armed with Frag and Krak Grenades.

abilities.name: Warp-Sighted Butcher
abilities.text: This Threat may make a free move in response to a target declaring a Charge action, and so interpose itself between the target the Threat being charged, and become the new target for the attack.

note: Print error copied as printed in Warp-Sighted Butcher: 'between the target the Threat being charged'. Keyword printed <MARK OF KHORNE> in place of <MARK OF CHAOS>.
